user.title: Commute Rain
user.description: Shared backend for all your commutes: one radar and one forecast request per update, used by every commute. Add commutes afterwards with "Add commute".

abort.single_instance_allowed: Commute Rain is already set up. Add more commutes to the existing entry.

data_description.max_rain_mm_per_h: A departure only counts as best if the rain never exceeds this on any part of the ride. The radar comes in steps of 0.12 mm/h.
data_description.always_poll_radar: Off: the radar is fetched every 5 min only from 2 h before a departure window until it ends.
data_description.demo_mode: Synthetic rain front crossing your routes every 90 min, instead of the live radar. For testing on dry days.

user.title: Commute
user.description: A commute has an outbound leg (e.g. to work) and a return leg (home).

data_description.segment_size: km when splitting by distance, minutes when splitting by time.

data_description.gpx_file: Recorded ride. Timestamps give the speed profile; without them, set the ride duration.
data_description.ride_duration_min: Leave empty to use the GPX timestamps.
data_description.forecast_start: Departure window for the 48 h forecast.
data_description.radar_start: Departure window for the 2 h radar. Empty start = from now.
data_description.radar_max_ahead_min: Rolling window: only departures up to this many minutes from now. Empty = no limit.

data_description.gpx_file: Recorded ride home. Leave empty to keep the current track or to reverse the outbound one.
data_description.ride_duration_min: Leave empty to use the GPX timestamps.
data_description.forecast_start: Departure window for the 48 h forecast.
data_description.radar_start: Departure window for the 2 h radar. Empty start = from now.
data_description.radar_max_ahead_min: Rolling window: only departures up to this many minutes from now. Empty = no limit.

error.invalid_gpx: The file is not a valid GPX track.
error.no_timestamps: The GPX track has no timestamps. Set the ride duration.
error.gpx_required: Upload a GPX track or use the outbound track reversed.
error.forecast_window_order: The forecast window must end after it starts.
